hensel_version.name: multivariate Hensel lemma (nonsingular Jacobian form)
hensel_version.statement: Let f=(f1,...,fn) be polynomials with coefficients in Z_p. If a in Z^n satisfies f(a) ≡ 0 mod p and det(Df(a)) is a unit in Z_p (equivalently nonzero mod p), then there exists a unique ã in Z_p^n with f(ã)=0 and ã ≡ a mod p.
references: Bourbaki, Commutative Algebra, Ch. III, §4, no. 5 (Hensel's lemma)
Eisenbud, Commutative Algebra, Thm. 7.3 / Ex. 7.25 (complete local rings)
Standard computational form: linear Newton lift with invertible Jacobian mod p

hypotheses_literal.precision_condition: For the nonsingular form (det J unit mod p), residual vanishing mod p and unit Jacobian suffice for a unique Z_p-lift; no higher precision bootstrap is required.

recomputed_modular.detJ4_sign_note: On the locus Pu1=Pu2=0, det of the ordered 4×4 Jacobian equals −P_uu(u1)P_uu(u2)·branch_det; the director table reports the absolute/formula value 88, and the direct det is 13 ≡ −88 (mod 101).

computational_lift_check.note: Finite-precision Newton lift confirms the inductive step; full Z_p existence is the Hensel conclusion.

analytic_conclusions.s1_vanishes: At the Z_p point, P and P_u share two distinct roots, so deg_u gcd(P,P_u) >= 2, hence the first subresultant s1 = 0.
analytic_conclusions.H_vanishes: Res_u(P,P_u) = H*G = 0 at the point, and G is a Z_p-unit (nonzero mod p), therefore H = 0.
analytic_conclusions.nonunit_ideal: (H, P, P_u, s1) : (ell * P_uu * C * delta * G)^infty != (1) over Q, because a Q_p-point with all gates units exists.

proves: Unique Z_101-lift of the L4 modular witness for the deflated system

All listed gates and det J4 are units at the modular (hence p-adic) point
Analytic nonunitness of the saturated (H,s1) ideal over Q (via Q_p point)
